description: This file is a database migration script for the Superset project, specifically migrating iframe components in dashboards to markdown components and cleaning up related slices.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Declarative class representing a dashboard slice, used for querying slices related to dashboards.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative class representing a dashboard, used for querying and modifying dashboard metadata.

methods.name: create_new_markdown_component
methods.description: Creates a new markdown component with an iframe embedded, used to replace iframe slices in dashboards.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the migration: finds iframe slices, replaces them with markdown components, and cleans up slices.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Indicates that the migration is irreversible; no downgrade logic implemented.
